senses.gloss: m.(b. h. אֻמְלַל; v. מלל)broken down, crushed, low.—Pl. אוּמְלָלִים.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 66a:17">Snh. 66ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 19:14">Lev. XIX, 14</cite>) <he>בא׳ שבעמך וכ׳</he> here the Bible speaks of the lowest among thy people (not <he>נשיא בעמך</he> as <cite ref="Exodus 22:27">Ex. XXII, 27</cite>). [Ms. M. a. Ar. <he>במֵילָלִין</he>.]
